Neural Machine Translation (NMT) systems are usually trained on datasets consisting of millions of parallel sentences, thus still performing poorly on low-resource languages, i.e., languages without a large amount of training data.
For evaluation, we use SentencePiece BLEU (spBLEU), as it is shown to be a fair metric in multilingual settings.
